Sir '''Trilag''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was one of the leaders of the [[Mecrosa Order]] of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], and under the codename "the Creeper" he was a member of the [[Star Cabal]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Trilag fell in battle aboard the [[Star Chamber (space station)|Star Chamber]] when [[Cipher Nine]], an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], infiltrated the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and wiped out the inner circle.
